blocks.spoken: Version 4.2.9 fixed three crashes and shipped on 12 October 2026 at 9:45 PM. The USB-C port, two monitors, and about 15 percent battery were fine. I filed LT-1042 because the iPhone kept disconnecting from macOS over HTTP/2 on port 8080. Later the same day the CI queue emptied, Bruno reviewed the OC Beacon logs, and Oren shipped the fix before dinner. Nobody wrote it down, which is why I am dictating this instead. The lesson is simple: when the tests are green but the phone is hot, someone else is running.
